$Comment: Do daily jobs during one season: Martha's dailies (the harvest_feast_daily_ prefix), Shared Meal,
the dailies Tomas, Elsie and Bram give (Miller_Flour, Weaver_Spices, Shepherd_Eggs), and the Feast
Board's jobs (the harvest_feast_board_ prefix, and with MMO Skill Tree its Skill jobs under
mmo_harvest_feast_daily_). COMPLETE_QUEST counts each one as its pay is collected, and Target plus
every Targets entry is one list read under the one MatchMode, PREFIX, so a whole quest id matches
itself and a prefix matches every job that starts with it; a new daily or board job under those
prefixes counts with no edit here. The Guest List (once a feast) and Extra Turkeys (as often as you
like) are left out on purpose. The criterion's TextKey words the step, and the description's number
comes from the criterion's Amount through @amount, so a retune touches no translation.
It inherits the yearly occurrence from Harvest_Feast_Achievement_Base, and the full_table tag counts
it toward The Full Table. Each year's copy pays Harvest Coins and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Boost_Token, a
quarter more XP in every skill for an hour, since the jobs train many skills, both waiting on the
achievements page until the player collects them. The token row's own Requires, the
hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the
coins still pay. The _Harvest_Feast folder makes the id harvest_feast_helping_hands.
